Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

FOREWORD 

This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on 25 January 1990, after 
the draft finalized by the Pesticides Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and 
Agriculture Division Council. 

Bromadiolone CB ( bait concentrate ) used as an anticoagulant rodenticide, is generally 
manufactured to contain 0'25 percent (m/m) of bromadiolone. 

In the preparation of this standard, due consideration has been given to the provisions of the 
InseciUtdes Act 1968 and the Rules framed thereunder. However, this standard is subject to the 
restrictions imposed under the Act and Rules, wherever applicable. 

For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, 
the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be 
rounded off in accordance with IS 2 ; I960 'Rules for rounding off numerical values ( rsvisedy. 
The number of significant places relained in the rounded off value should be the same as that 
of the specified value in this standard.

BROMADIOLONE CB — SPECIFIC ATION 



1 SCOPE 

1,1 This standard prescribes the requirements 
and the methods of test for bromadiolone CB 
used in the preparation of rodent baits.

necessary adjuncts to this Standard:

3 REQpIR£M£NTS 

3.1 Gonstitiieiits 

3.1.1 The material shall consist of bromadiolone, 
technical^ compounded with talc or other 
suitable diluent {g}. 

3.1.2 Bromadiolone, technical used in the 
formulation of bromadiolone GB shall conform 
Lo IS 12914: 1990 

3.2 Description 

The material shall be in the form of free- flowing 
powder y devoid of lumps ahd extraneous 
impurities. 

3.3 Sieving Requirements 

When tested by the method prescribed in 12.1.2.1 
of IS 6940 : 1982, not less than 95 percent by 
dry weight of the material taken for the test 
shall pass through 75-micron IS Sieve [ see IS 4fi0 
(Part 1 ) : 1985] 

3.4 Bromadiolone Content 

3.4-1 When determined by the method prescri- 
bed in 7.1,1 of this standard and Annex A of 
IS 12914 : 1990, bromadiolone content, percent, 
( m/m ), of any of the samples shall not differ 



from the nominaJ value by more than the 
percent tolerances applied to the declared 
nominal value The tolerances shall be _ j^ 
percent of the nominal value. 

3.4.2 The average bromadiolone content of all 
samples taken shall act be less than the declared 
nominal content. 

4 PACKING 

4.1 The materia] shall be packed in paper-poly 

pouches 

5 MARKING 

5,1 The container shall bear legibly and indeli- 
bly the following information and any other 
iriformation as is necessary under the Insfciicides 
Act, 1968 and Rules: 

a) Name of the material; 

b) Indication of the source o£ raa.mifacture; 

c) Date of manufacture and date of expiry; 

d) Batch number; 

ej Active ingredient content, percent (m/m); 

f ) Net mass of contents; and 

g) The minimum cautionary notice as 
worded in Insecticides Act, 1968 and Rules. 

6 SAMPLE 

6,1 Representative samples of the material shall 
be drawn as prescribed in IS 10627 : 1983. 

7 TESTS 

7,1 'Vests shall be carried out by the mathods 
referred to in 3.2 to 3.4 and 7.1.1. 

7.1.1 Weigh accurately about 10 g of sample 
in an Erlenmeyer flask, add about 50 ml of 
methanol, shake well. Gently warm for 10 
minutes to dissolve the active ingredient and 
lilter through cotton plug. Wash twice with 
2.^ ml portions of methanol each time and 
collect the filtrate in a conical Hask. Paws the 
filtrate through G-5 sintered funnel using 
vacuum, collect in a lOO-ml volumetric flask and 
mate up the volume. Take out 2 ml of this 
solution with a pipette in a 50-ml volumetric 
flask. Follow the procedure as described 
in A-4.2a to A-4.4 of IS L2914 : 1990. Calculate 
bioinadiolone content, percent by mass, by
